name: B210 SDR synchronization for NR base station and UE

mentions.name: B210 SDR synchronization for NR base station and UE
mentions.description: An attempt to synchronize two B210 SDRs running on separate systems as a 5G NR base station and user equipment without GPSDOs or an external PPS signal. After initial sync the two SDRs drifted by a significant amount within a couple of seconds, so timing and frequency offsets were compensated every SSB, assuming synchronization held for two frame durations (2x1024us); the project was later abandoned.
mentions.problem: GPSDOs were too costly and no external PPS was available; after initial sync the two SDRs drifted by a significant amount within a couple of seconds.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was trying to synchronize two B210s running on different systems as NR BS and UE.. GPSDOs were too costly and I did not have external PPS.
